meta.contactLog: Contact Enrichment Log tab (sheet-backed cache; reads + appends only; dedupe by enrichment_key)
meta.approvedWriteSurface: update on Approved Outreach matching lead_id writing only the two enrichment-owned columns (contact_blocked, contact_source_provider) plus the five handoff-empty contact fields (schema.js ownership contract)
meta.emptyRunBehavior: Prepare nodes emit [] when the scope is empty; with alwaysOutputData a run with nothing to do reaches Consolidate with zero items and routes to No-Op End (no writes, no report)
meta.fatalBehavior: a fatal provider failure (AgentData/Hunter auth, missing provider) halts the contact engine, Prepare OSS Fallback Scope emits [], and the fatal-only run routes to No-Op End (Consolidate._hasOutput false)
